name: BRD Stablecoin
oneLiner: BRD is a pre-launch Brazilian real stablecoin from CF Inovacao, backed by Brazilian Treasury bonds and structured to pass Selic-rate yield back to holders.
collateral: Brazilian National Treasury bonds (LTN/NTN-B); yield from the Selic-linked rate (currently ~15%) is structured to be shared with token holders
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint/redemption against BRL subscriptions held in trust at CF Inovacao S.A.; the underlying Treasury-bond portfolio is the reserve, and accrued interest is passed back to holders rather than retained by the issuer

jurisdiction.regulator: Banco Central do Brasil (Consulta Publica 111 pending)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: BRD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and a single Brazilian issuer (CF Inovacao) controls mint and redemption authority.

launchPhaseDetail: Announced Jan 6 2026 on 'Cripto na Real' by former Brazil central bank deputy governor Tony Volpon (BCB 2015-16, ex-UBS/Nomura MD); to be issued by CF Inovacao (co-founded with Jose Carneiro in 2023), targeting institutional investors who want on-chain access to Selic-rate yield (~15%); positioned as the first BRL-pegged token to explicitly share government-debt yield with holders, competing against Crown's BRLV which raised a $13.5M Series A from Paradigm in December 2025; no formal product docs or deployment timeline yet; awaiting BCB Resolution implementation under Public Consultation 111 (FX-classification regime effective February 2 2026); BCB Resolution 561 (published Apr 30 2026, effective Oct 1 2026) further bans stablecoin/crypto settlement in regulated cross-border FX, tightening the regulatory backdrop

featuredContent.title: Former Brazil central bank official unveils real-pegged stablecoin with yield sharing
featuredContent.description: Tony Volpon's CF Inovacao to issue BRD, a BRL token backed by Brazilian Treasury bonds with the Selic-linked yield (~15%) passed through to holders.

featuredContent.title: BRD joins Brazil's stablecoin race with yield-sharing digital real
featuredContent.description: Competitive landscape against Transfero BRZ ($185M), BBRL ($51M), BRL1, and Crown BRLV; structural differentiation through explicit yield distribution to holders.

milestones.title: Tony Volpon unveils BRD yield-sharing BRL stablecoin on 'Cripto na Real'
milestones.description: Former BCB deputy governor announces CF Inovacao-issued BRD, backed by Brazilian government debt with Selic-rate yield distributed to holders; positions BRD against existing BRL stablecoins and Paradigm-backed Crown BRLV.

milestones.title: Brazil stablecoin FX-classification regime takes effect
milestones.description: BCB resolutions classifying stablecoin transactions as foreign-exchange operations enter force; BRD launch deferred pending issuer compliance under the new regime and final Consulta Publica 111 output.

milestones.title: BCB Resolution 561 bans stablecoin settlement in regulated cross-border FX
milestones.description: Brazil's central bank publishes Resolution 561 (effective Oct 1 2026) prohibiting authorised FX providers from using stablecoins or crypto to settle cross-border remittances — a restrictive backdrop for BRD, though it does not name CF Inovacao.
